info.name: Grocery Application API
info.description:
Full Postman collection for the Django REST grocery_application backend.

Base URL: http://localhost:8000 (override via {{base_url}})

Auth: Session-based (rest_framework.authentication.SessionAuthentication). After signing in via /api/auth/v1/signin/ or /api/auth/v1/verify-otp/, the `sessionid` cookie is set automatically by Postman's cookie jar; CSRF is exempted on auth endpoints. For state-changing requests outside the auth app you may need an `X-CSRFToken` header (Postman pulls `csrftoken` from cookies — see the test scripts on the sign-in requests).

Environment variables expected:
- base_url            (e.g. http://localhost:8000)
- customer_email
- customer_password
- delivery_username
- delivery_password
- admin_email
- admin_password
- product_id, variant_id, category_id, order_id, address_id, checkout_id, etc. (populated as you go)
- razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, razorpay_signature
- otp_phone, otp_code

exec: // Inject CSRF token from cookies (csrftoken) into the X-CSRFToken header for unsafe methods.
// On successful sign-in the sessionid cookie is set in Postman's cookie jar.
